credentials.description: service ID — the user part of HTTP Basic auth, base64(SERVICE_ID:SECRET_TOKEN)
secret token — the password part of HTTP Basic auth

example_prompt: Check the delivery status of an SMS I sent via NimbaSMS.

id.description: Unique message identifier returned by send_message (messageid field).

sent_at.description: Send time as a Unix timestamp (seconds). Convert with new Date(sent_at * 1000).

gotchas: The identifier field in the response is 'messageid' (not 'id'). Use the messageid returned by send_message.
sent_at is a Unix timestamp in seconds (integer), not an ISO 8601 date. Convert with new Date(sent_at * 1000) in JavaScript.
The overall status ('status') can be 'sent' while some recipients in 'numbers' have status 'failure' or 'not_available'. Inspect 'numbers' for the per-recipient status.
The 'received' status in 'numbers' means delivered (delivery receipt received from the carrier). 'sent' means sent to the carrier but not yet confirmed delivered.
open_questions: Sandbox: provider.json declares none and no gotcha documents a test environment — every call reaches production.
